settings.privacyNoticeSub: Information this app handles and sends externally
settings.privacyNoticeBody:
Signing in shares your social provider's authentication info and account identifiers with our server. Service data such as your nickname, island and resident activity, friends and letters, and focus records is also stored on the server to provide features and keep them in sync.

Screen usage and key feature events are sent to PostHog, and screen and request diagnostics may be sent to Datadog when configured. If you allow Screen Time permission, the app reads your selected app usage time on-device for goals and stats. You can find the full details and retention periods in the Privacy Policy. Requesting account deletion asks the server to delete your account.

guide.line1:
Hey! You're a new face.
I'm Mongdol. I've lived on this island for a long time.
guide.line2:
This used to be a lively island with lots of visitors.
But at some point everyone stopped coming, and now it's an island nobody visits anymore.
guide.line3:
With you here, I think we can bring this island back to life.
Want to help me revive it together?
guide.line4:
Great, let's start with the first step to revive the island.
Here, the time you spend focusing becomes the power that grows the island.
You'll quickly get the hang of it once you try it yourself.
